title: Signal: NuGet accepts packages without a valid signature
scope: A nuget.config file that declares a `signatureValidationMode` of `accept`, which does not require a signed package.
limitations: It matches a `signatureValidationMode` of `accept`, which does not require a signed package in the parsed nuget.config; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
fpNotes: A nuget.config that mentions a `signatureValidationMode` of `accept`, which does not require a signed package in a comment, a documentation example or a template placeholder is not reported; the rule reads the parsed value that the installer acts on.
